parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the details. I’m sorry the new analyst is running into an “access denied” message after accepting the invite.

Because this appears to be specific to one newly invited user (while other users can access normally), we’ll need to review the account/workspace access setup for that user and the invite that was sent.

To help us investigate quickly, could you please reply with the following:
1) The analyst’s name and email/username (exactly as used for the invite)
2) The exact “access denied” message text, and where it shows up (app/URL/step)
3) The workspace/account/org she’s trying to access (workspace name or ID)
4) What role/permissions were assigned in the invite
5) Whether she can log in to the platform at all—specifically: does login succeed and only workspace access fails, or does she fail at login?
6) Invite acceptance time (approx.) and whether she could access at any point after accepting
7) Any screenshot and/or request ID/error code shown during the attempt

Once we have that, we’ll escalate for human review to restore her access as soon as possible today.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue for human review once the requested details are provided
Work to restore access as soon as possible today (subject to investigation results)
safety_notes: Avoid promising a specific fix or turnaround time; request missing details required for investigation.
Do not infer root cause (e.g., permissions vs. invite configuration) beyond what the customer reported.
